ValidationRule.description: An underwriter must be assigned from Underwriting onward.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Underwriting"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Credit Review"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Conditionally Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Closing"), ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Booked")), ISBLANK(Underwriter__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assign an Underwriter before moving the application into Underwriting.
